categories.main_business_segments: Liaoning Chengda Biotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of human vaccines. Its main marketed products include human rabies vaccine and human Japanese encephalitis (JE) inactivated vaccine. The company also has a rich pipeline of vaccines under development, including diploid cell rabies vaccine, quadrivalent and trivalent influenza vaccines, 15-valent HPV vaccine, 13-valent and 20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccines, recombinant shingles vaccine, multivalent hand-foot-mouth disease vaccine, group B meningococcal vaccine, and rabies monoclonal antibody drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced bioreactor-based large-scale cell culture technology for vaccine production, including Vero cell and diploid cell platforms. It has established four major R&D technology platforms: bacterial vaccine technology (including polysaccharide conjugation and outer membrane vesicle (OMV) technology), viral vaccine technology (including virus-like particle (VLP) technology), multivalent vaccine technology, and recombinant protein vaccine technology. The production process involves high-density suspension culture, continuous virus harvest, virus concentration, inactivation, and chromatography purification, adhering to GMP standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include over 2,000 disease control centers across China and clients from more than 30 countries and regions globally, especially along the Belt and Road countries such as Thailand, Egypt, and India. The primary markets served are domestic and international human vaccine markets, with a focus on rabies and Japanese encephalitis vaccines. The company also targets pediatric and adult populations for vaccination programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenyang and Benxi, Liaoning Province, and has a subsidiary in Shenzhen. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports vaccines to over 30 countries, including Thailand, Egypt, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Brazil, focusing on Belt and Road Initiative countries. The company is expanding its international market presence through partnerships and regulatory approvals.
categories.supply_chain_position: Liaoning Chengda Biotechnology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the vaccine supply chain, encompassing vaccine R&D, manufacturing, quality control, and direct sales. It manages procurement of raw materials, vaccine production, quality assurance, and distribution to end customers, including disease control centers and international distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding its vaccine portfolio with innovative and multivalent vaccines. It integrates R&D resources across multiple centers, accelerates clinical trials and regulatory approvals, and builds new production bases. Strategic priorities include developing recombinant protein vaccines, nucleic acid vaccines, and long-acting monoclonal antibodies, as well as leveraging AI technologies to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of vaccines to domestic disease control centers and international distributors. The company employs a direct sales model domestically supported by a professional sales team and a distributor model internationally. Revenue streams include product sales of human vaccines, with pricing influenced by market demand and government procurement policies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic human rabies vaccine market, maintaining the largest market share for over 17 years. It competes with multiple domestic vaccine manufacturers amid increasing market competition and capacity surplus. Globally, the vaccine industry is dominated by multinational companies like Merck, GSK, Sanofi, and Pfizer, but Liaoning Chengda is a key domestic player with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.676 billion, a 4.22% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 342.8 million, down 26.42%. R&D investment increased by 18.09% to RMB 494.2 million, accounting for 29.49% of revenue. The company has total assets of about RMB 10 billion and maintains a stable financial position with a low debt ratio of 4.87%. Despite revenue decline due to market competition, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and effective vaccines with advanced production technologies and strong clinical evidence. Its rabies vaccine offers convenient immunization schedules (Zagreb 2-1-1 and Essen 5-dose methods) with proven safety and efficacy, used in over 1.2 billion doses globally without reported immunization failures. The JE inactivated vaccine is the only domestically marketed product of its kind, free from antibiotics, formaldehyde, gelatin, and preservatives, suitable for special populations. The company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities, along with extensive sales networks, provide competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
